$comment: Raw minified bytes per route, gated by scripts/check-bundle.mjs after vite build (gzip is reported, not gated). Entry = first load. A page builder who needs more raises its own line in the same change and says why. door = @shadowrunr/contract's compiled ajv validators, loaded in parallel with the first paint. WPI re-budget, measured: (1) the entry no longer imports the ui barrel, so the shared ui kit (FilterTable, VirtualList with TanStack Virtual, Section and the rest: one 39,055 B js / 4,451 B css chunk) left the first paint (entry 317,322 -> 277,523 B js, 44,318 -> 36,688 B css) and now loads with the first layer 2; every layer-2 js line is 60,000 for the page plus 40,000 for that shared chunk, counted once per route by check-bundle's closure. (2) layer-2 css lines rise by the ui css each page now carries (it was in the entry): characters.l2 24,000 (17.5 KB page incl. the promoted Markdown prose + 4.5 KB kit), segments.l2 22,000, reconcile.l2 26,000 (FilterTable, RateBar, StatBand, kit css: 8.3 KB). (3) door 280,000 -> 320,000: typed tournament.results (TournamentResults with its cells, tallies, bounds, latency and usage), reconcile.incidents, the report's red_line_counts and synthesis_input, CommandInfo and the character fields added 52,443 B of standalone validators (257,445 -> 309,888 B); splitting the validators per method is codegen work in packages/contract. C2 cutover, measured: the pre-port desk and its mock were deleted, so their two lines went, and so did tauri.opener, whose only importer was that desk (17 -> 14 routes; entry 271.0 -> 269.8 KiB js, 35.8 -> 35.7 KiB css; every other line within 0.1 KiB). P7, measured: brain.l2 css 16,000 -> 17,000 (16,212 B: the pre-flight board's Preflight.module.css and the transcript viewer's Open in stage button); onair.l1 css 24,000 -> 24,500 (24,083 B: the transport's Pre-flight red link). Clips, measured: door 330,000 -> 410,000 (395,016 B: the seven clips.* methods add the ClipCandidate, ClipsPage, ClipScanReport and ClipPublishReport validators with their nested window, signals, gate, render and evidence shapes); onair.l2 css 16,000 -> 19,500 (18,804 B: the Clips tab's Clips.module.css, the funnel rows, window bar, gate checklist and owner-act forms). Sandbox, measured: door 410,000 -> 430,000 (about 421,300 B: the three sandbox.* methods add the SandboxStartParams, SandboxStarted, SandboxStatus and SandboxReport validators with their checks and judge, and every StreamEvent validator gains the health variant). Session review, measured: entry 280,000 -> 286,000 (283,396 B: the seventh poster face, its sessions hook and the review tokens); door 430,000 -> 470,000 (462,014 B: the five review.* methods add the ReviewSession, ReviewSessionRow, SessionTags and LineFeedback validators, and Role gains tagger); review.l1 and review.l2 start at the standard 60,000 / 100,000 js lines, to be re-measured when the page is built. Measured when built: review.l1 52,839 B js / 8,448 B css; review.l2 88,268 B js / 28,148 B css, so review.l2 css 24,000 -> 30,000 (the timeline, drawer, script, feedback panel and the five tab modules together). UI-2, Review in the console's own style, measured: review.l2 css 30,000 -> 35,000 (28,160 -> 34,148 B: the page now prints through the shared primitives, so the StatBand, Switch, RateBar and Button chunks (4,095 B) and the Chip, PillGroup and ui/Drawer css join its closure; its private drawer, button and card styles were deleted). UI-3, the polish pass, measured: segments.l2 css 22,000 -> 22,500 (21,513 -> 22,358 B: the ranks form submit and the invalid-route link now print through ui/Button, so its css chunk joins the closure; the private .btn and .secondary rules were deleted). Stream prep, measured: door 470,000 -> 500,000 (489,758 B: the five prep.* methods add the StreamPrep, PrepSummary and params validators, and StreamEvent gains beat_plan). Screens contract, measured: door 510,000 -> 516,000 (513,501 B: the op validators gain show_screen with ScreenId, and StreamEvent gains record_shown with ShownRecord).
